title: Device Identity
description: M10.0 per-device descriptor for multi-device sync. Stored at $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/agent-continuity/device-identity.json (defaults to ~/.config/...). Generated on the first push/pull invocation if absent. DISTINCT from AdapterIdentity (M9): devices are hosts; adapters are participants that run ON a host. A device may host multiple adapters; an adapter may move between devices.

device_id.description: Stable per-device identifier. Format: '{hostname}-{8-hex}'. Generated once and persisted; never re-derived from hostname alone since hostnames can collide across machines (two laptops both named 'macbook-air').

hostname.description: Captured socket.gethostname() at identity generation. Diagnostic only — device_id is the canonical key for sync attribution.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when this identity was minted.
